lineage: modelc (v1, B0=21.7 GPa DFT BM-EOS, ordered Li 0K — legacy) →
modelc_v2_mlip (annealing champion, B0=20.0 GPa MLIP, -2.1 GPa softer) →
modelc_v3 (Pipeline v2 §8 DFT post-processing at the annealing-champion V0)

pipeline_v2_lineage_full._description: Full step-by-step trail from anion ordering to §8 properties (paper-grade audit).

step_1_halogen_enumeration.description: Anion site disorder (S²⁻ ↔ Cl⁻) at 4a / 4d Wyckoff. Cl-only here so trivial (Cl always on 8 free sites).

step_2_two_stage_MLIP_screening.description: Halogen → Li screening with UMA-s-1p1 (omat). 45 halogen × 100 Li = 4500 trials.

step_3_li_anneal.description: Li sublattice anneal: UMA-MD Langevin 500 K, 50 ps per Li trial × top 20.
step_3_li_anneal.method: Langevin (UMA-s-1p1 omat), T=500 K, t=50 ps

step_4_mlip_eos.description: MLIP volume sweep around champion V to bracket DFT V0.

step_5_dft_relax_at_champion.description: DFT relax of champion structure at V_init (champion volume). Yields starting coords for BM-EOS.

step_6_dft_eos_11pts.description: DFT volume sweep at champion: 11 volumes v096-v106, each cell-fixed relax.

BM3_fit_LEGACY_v2._status: LEGACY backup only — superseded by PRIMARY
BM3_fit_LEGACY_v2._kept_for: reproducibility audit; do NOT report in paper headline

step_7_v0_confirmation.description: Take v101 (= minimum volume) coords, perform additional BFGS relax → final V0_relax. Cell essentially identical to v101 (Δ ≤ 5e-4 in lattice vector components); atomic positions refined by ~0.001 frac (BFGS micro-step).

step_8_post_processing.description: All §8a-h done at the V0_relax coordinates (see v3_postprocess_pipeline_v2_8 section below).
list: LOBSTER ICOHP (PAW SCF + NSCF) — in progress

all_pipeline_steps_consistent_check.conclusion: All §8 post-processing operates at the BM-EOS-determined V0 of the annealing champion structure. The full pipeline (steps 1-7) supports the §8 results without any inconsistency.

8e_bader.method: Henkelman bader v1.05 on plot_num=17 (AE density)
8e_bader.notes: 365 maxima associated to 62 atoms by MIC; per-atom charges: Li +0.882, Cl -0.916, S/P/N...

8f_dos_pdos.notes: Initial detection issues (E_F inside valence band, vacuum region detection) resolved by restricting search to E > -3 eV.

8d_elastic_static.method: stress-strain finite-difference (12 SCFs ±0.005, 6 Voigt patterns), full 6×6 Cij via stress tensor σ = -(1/V) ∂E/∂ε with QE sign flip

8g_aimd_mlip_transport.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) Langevin NVT AIMD, 600/800/1000 K, equilib 10 ps + prod 100 ps each, MSD linear fit (2-50 ps) + Arrhenius + Nernst-Einstein

comparison_to_expt_LPSCl.sigma_300K_Scm: 14e-3 calc vs 2-5e-3 expt → 3-5× overshoot (typical foundation MLIP + Haven ratio assumption)

8g_aimd_mlip_transport.interpretation: Li-only conductor confirmed (Cl/P/S framework diffusion ~5× lower than Li). Ea matches experiment quantitatively. Absolute σ overshoot is consistent with UMA foundation MLIP bias and would be corrected by Haven ratio H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 typical for SE.

elastic_dft_0K_GPa.method: stress-strain full Cij with QE sign flip (12 SCFs, 2026-06-02)

vs_modelc_v1_DFT_C44.delta_pct: -48.6% — Li disorder basin (v3 disordered, v1 ordered 0K)

comparison_targets.notes: modelC_v3 B_VRH (from stress-strain Cij) provides INDEPENDENT cross-check vs the BM-EOS K values from earlier runs. ±5% agreement = both methods consistent.
